name: Iwabe Musashi
source:
The idol producer of Baby☆Macaron, the group [url=/c156951]Kokone[/url] belongs to.
Having lived in Akihabara for many years, he may look like an elderly man, but his booming voice, energetic movements, and habit of throwing his whole heart into either joy or worry make him an endlessly lively and restless presence.
He peppers his rapid-fire speech with old-fashioned entertainment industry jargon, overwhelming almost everyone he meets for the first time.
He was once known as a hitmaker, but these days the only act signed to the Iwabe Talent Agency, which he founded himself, is Baby☆Macaron. With little new work coming in, the agency has become an extremely small operation.

[From in-game profile]
